summary: Crypto sentiment is mildly bullish overall today, with BTC, ETH, and HYPE showing supportive price action while broad market tone remains risk-on after cooler U.S. jobs data. The strongest new idea surfaced is AVAX, while macro commentary is also leaning constructive for gold and mixed-to-soft for the dollar and crude.
